text_block_list.text: Phew! That's it for praying today.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
I've been kinda off my game lately, so
hopefully
this will bring me some luck.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: CHECK!
text_block_list.name: Сакура Бакушин-О

text_block_list.text:
What was that? That voice sounded
really
familiar...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
For starters, that's a bishop, not a lance.
And this
is shogi, not chess. Here we
say... Oute!
text_block_list.name: Shogi Master of the Shopping District

text_block_list.text: UGHHH! I lost again!
text_block_list.name: Сакура Бакушин-О

text_block_list.text:
Hey, if it isn't the stationary shop owner
and
Bakushin O. How are you guys
doing?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
You defeated me! ME! The genius! You
must've
been a famously hard-working
student as well!
text_block_list.name: Сакура Бакушин-О

text_block_list.text:
Bwahaha! It's been half a century since I
was a
student! Natie is really good at
this game too, by
the way.
text_block_list.name: Shogi Master of the Shopping District

text_block_list.text:
Ohoho, we'll see about that! Nature! I
challenge
you to a game of shogi!
text_block_list.name: Сакура Бакушин-О

text_block_list.text:
Now hold on! I just played a bit when I
was a kid!
And it was just against
customers at my mom's
bar!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Besides, I don't want to waste my
trainer's time...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер
choice_data_list:
But if you win this, we can start the day on a
high note.

text_block_list.text: Oooh. You're good, Trainer. Now I've gotta win.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
And so, their battle begins atop the
shogi board.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
(Hmmm... It looks like I can end this in
about two
more turns. It all depends on
whether I sacrifice
this piece or not.)
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: ...This is it!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Aaand... Oute!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Ah, you win! You're really good, Natie!
text_block_list.name: Shogi Master of the Shopping District

text_block_list.text: What a graceful play! I salute you!
text_block_list.name: Сакура Бакушин-О

text_block_list.text:
I don't know what to say to such
straightforward
compliments.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
You have to face me next, Nature! This
time, I'll
definitely win!
text_block_list.name: Сакура Бакушин-О

text_block_list.text: What?! But you said only one game...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Geez, okay. I'll do it for you, Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Ughhh... You win!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Gyahaha! You tripped up in the last
turn! It seems
you weren't confident
enough in your move.
text_block_list.name: Shogi Master of the Shopping District

text_block_list.text:
My mind is a bit foggy today... I guess
it's not that
easy for me to get back into
the groove.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Nature! When in doubt, all you have to
do is...
Bakushin!
text_block_list.name: Сакура Бакушин-О

text_block_list.text: Huh? I've got to do what now?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
You just have to Bakushin ahead with
the lance
piece! Bakushin!
text_block_list.name: Сакура Бакушин-О

text_block_list.text:
Well, actually, that does beat sitting
around and
second-guessing yourself... I
guess.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Найс Нэйчер also wins the next game
handily!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Найс Нэйчер plays another game... but
she loses
her king to her opponent's
bishop.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
